title: Create
description: Create new mosaic patterns from scratch.

title: Import image
description: Import any image.  You can resize the image and the app will convert the image to 2 colors black and white, allowing you to adjust the threshold.

title: Export
description: Export your design to a PDF that includes the chart and a written pattern.

title: Custom instructions
description: Create a PDF of instructions for your pattern using your favorite editor and include that at the beginning of the exported pattern.
